incidents.summary: Delaware River Waterfront Corporation sued Sage Software, alleging that a security loophole in its accounting software enabled a former employee to embezzle $2.4 million.

sources.title: DELAWARE RIVER WATERFRONT CORPORATION v. THE SAGE GROUP PLC (2022)
sources.quote: DRWC brought this action to recover $2.4 million dollars that a former employee embezzled using the software.

sources.title: DELAWARE RIVER WATERFRONT CORPORATION v. THE SAGE GROUP PLC (2022)
sources.quote: It contends that Wellspring misrepresented PrintBoss’s security in its marketing materials and on its website, and that Sage’s software program had a security loophole that enabled the embezzlement scheme.

incidents.summary: Sage acknowledged that its Copilot assistant showed unrelated business information to a small number of customers, temporarily suspended the service and reported implementing a fix.

sources.title: Sage Copilot grounded briefly to fix AI misbehavior
sources.quote: Sage Group plc has confirmed it temporarily suspended its Sage Copilot, an AI assistant for the UK-based business software maker's accounting tools, this month after it blurted customer information to other users.

sources.title: Sage Copilot grounded briefly to fix AI misbehavior
sources.quote: The issue showed unrelated business information to a very small number of customers. At no point were any invoices exposed.

sources.title: Sage Copilot grounded briefly to fix AI misbehavior
sources.quote: The fix is fully implemented and Sage Copilot is performing as expected.

positives: SBTi validated Sage's target to halve emissions across all scopes by 2030 against a 2019 baseline, aligned with a 1.5°C pathway.
